_about: PROPOSAL (Sal, 2026-10-31). Read by nothing yet; the crop table for the farming code (FARMING_SPEC.md). 12 crops. grow_days = game days sowing to ripe, water_per_day = buckets per bed per game day (0 if rain-fed), seed_source = the wild plant that gives seeds so a player starts from forage, store = how it keeps (drying, salting, root cellar). Agronomy numbers (days to maturity, soil, storage) are general growing knowledge for temperate crops, approximate and not individually sourced; a game day is one real hour so real months are scaled down by the code owner. Items for all 12 crops and their seeds exist (332 to 337 and 374 to 385); the wild-seed drops, the cellar and the drying rack do not. 2026-10-31 audit against Tyler's farming rules: the server compares `sow_season` to the current season as ONE string (turnip is hard-coded as always sowable), and a new world starts on day 100, early summer, so spring-only crops could not be sown for 265 real hours. `sow_season` is now the single season the code accepts (summer for nearly all crops except wheat and barley, which stay spring because test_farming sows them in spring: a summer-start player grows oats and the vegetables first; so a new player can plant on day 1; rye autumn; turnip spring but exempt) and `sow_seasons` keeps the realistic list (wheat spring and summer, rye autumn, turnip spring and autumn...) for when the code accepts a list.

storage_chain.drying: Drying rack (new structure, 4 sticks + twine 4): berries, herbs, peas, meat strips; item Jerky = raw meat 2 + salt 1 on the rack
storage_chain.salting: Salt (sea salt, WATER_GATHER_SPEC.md) + fish or meat into a clay jug: Salted fish, Salted meat
storage_chain.root_cellar: Root cellar (dug room, needs 24 stone + 6 lumber, hammer blueprint): root crops keep 4 to 6 months, spoilage x0.25
storage_chain.ferment: Cabbage + salt in a jug: sauerkraut keeps 6 months (needs salt)

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.seed_source: wild tall grass in grassland, late summer (1 to 3 seeds)
wheat.store: dry in the sheaf, grain keeps 12 months in a dry store

barley.name: Barley
barley.store: dry grain keeps 12 months; also malting and ale later

oats.name: Oats
oats.seed_source: wild grass on heath and boreal edges

rye.name: Rye
rye.seed_source: wild grass in dry grassland, autumn
rye.store: dry grain keeps 12 months; sown in autumn, overwinters

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.store: root cellar: keeps 4 to 5 months cool and dark

potato.name: Potato
potato.seed_source: dig a wild tuber with a spade
potato.store: root cellar: keeps 5 to 6 months in the dark

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.seed_source: wild sea cabbage on beaches, summer
cabbage.store: cellar 3 to 4 months, or salted into a ferment (needs sea salt)

onion.name: Onion
onion.seed_source: wild garlic and ramsons bulbs, spring (nearest wild source)

peas.name: Peas
peas.store: dry the pods: keeps 12 months; fresh only a few days

flax.name: Flax
flax.seed_source: wild flax, summer (already a plant here)
flax.store: dry sheaves; retting and spinning later (linen)
